name: lnbits
summary: Lightning Network wallet and extension platform for fast Bitcoin-native micropayment workflows.
why_it_matters: LNbits keeps useful Lightning payments knowledge in the repo, but current Vrooli usage does not justify maintaining it as a supported payment integration.
when_to_use: A future scenario needs Lightning-powered micropayments.
Operators want wallet-centric Bitcoin payment flows with programmable APIs.
The workflow depends on extensions or LNURL-style payment UX.

platform_support.notes: The app is containerizable, but real support depends on Lightning backends, wallet security, and operational ownership.

implementation_notes: Promotion should define supported backends and wallet flows explicitly.
Keep payment application logic separate from wallet infrastructure support.
Do not imply production-safe financial operations without end-to-end validation.
operational_notes: Security, backup, and recovery are the critical operator concerns.
Validation should include invoice generation and settlement behavior.
Extension management can create drift if left unconstrained.
risks: Payments tooling creates real financial consequences when support is shallow.
Backend-specific differences make generic support unreliable.
